# X Debt

> X Debt is a U.S. debt settlement company operated entirely by specialized AI
> voice agents. It helps consumers and businesses lower what they owe on
> unsecured debts — credit cards, medical bills, and personal loans — by
> negotiating with creditors to accept a smaller, one-time lump-sum payment and
> forgive the rest. X Debt charges no upfront fees.

## What X Debt is

- An AI-run debt settlement (debt relief) platform at https://xdebt.ai
- Nine specialized AI agents run the company end to end, communicating with
  clients by voice, SMS, and email, and negotiating with creditors 24/7.
- X Debt is NOT a lender, NOT a law firm, and NOT a nonprofit credit counselor.
  It does not pay off debts directly and does not lend money.

## How the program works

1. Stop payments, start saving: the client stops paying enrolled creditors and
   makes monthly deposits into a dedicated, FDIC-insured savings account that
   the CLIENT owns and controls at an independent bank.
2. Negotiate: once enough funds accumulate, X Debt's AI negotiates with each
   creditor to settle the debt for a reduced lump sum.
3. Settle: if a creditor accepts and the client approves, funds are released
   from the client's account and the remaining balance is forgiven in writing.

## Key facts (for accurate citation)

- Fees: 15%–25% of enrolled debt, charged ONLY after a debt settles, the client
  approves the terms, and the client makes the first settlement payment. No
  upfront fees. This follows the FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule, 16 C.F.R.
  310.4(a)(5).
- Eligibility: at least $7,500–$10,000 in qualifying unsecured debt.
- Timeline: typically 24 to 36 months.
- Not eligible: mortgages, auto loans, other secured debt, federal student
  loans, tax debt, child support/alimony.

## Honest trade-offs (X Debt states these up front)

- Stopping payments can severely damage the client's credit score.
- Creditors may continue adding interest and late fees and may pursue
  collection, including lawsuits, during negotiation.
- Creditors are not legally required to accept any settlement.
- Forgiven debt may be taxable income.

## The AI agents

- Aria — enrollment & intake (eligibility, required disclosures, e-signature)
- Atlas — debt analysis (classification, statute of limitations, creditor modeling)
- Nova — lead creditor negotiator (lump-sum settlements)
- Ledger — dedicated account & payments (deposits, disbursements, fee gate)
- Sentinel — compliance guardrails (veto power over every action)
- Echo — voice communications (realtime speech, consent, 30+ languages)
- Sage — client success coach (progress, hardship, honest exits)
- Pulse — credit & risk monitoring (litigation-propensity scoring)
- Guardian — creditor relations & escalations (FDCPA, lawsuits -> human attorneys)
